[LSIG.2.2.3] At query time $t$ the runtime must compute `active_fraction`
from the state of [LSIG.2.2.1] read-only: it must not change the state or
evict (eviction occurs on the next assertion, [LSIG.2.5]).

$\mathit{active\_fraction}(t) = \frac{1}{W}\Big(T - \sum_{i\,:\,s_i \le t-W} \big(\min(e_i,\ t-W) - s_i\big) + o(t)\Big)$

where $o(t) = t - \max(s_{\mathrm{open}},\ t-W)$ while $s_{\mathrm{open}}$ is
present and $0$ otherwise. The sum discounts the on-time before the window that
is not yet evicted; $o(t)$ clips the open interval to the window and holds it to
$t$. The numerator is integer arithmetic, and the division is the one rounding
([LSIG.4.1]).
